granularity.soil: one Soil Health Card profile per district (2023-25 samples), applied to every year
granularity.weather: one value per district, season window and year (IMD gridded data); a state's figure is the mean of its districts
granularity.implication: Both describe a district, not a field, and the soil is a recent snapshot: it says which nutrients are scarce, not how the soil changed over the years.
